_about: Page families of the readers panel: the ONE table mapping a request path (as Cloudflare Web Analytics reports it) to a family. A path matches an `exact` entry, or an entry in `prefix` at a segment boundary (/daily matches /daily and /daily/2026-11-03, not /dailyx). First family that matches wins; nothing matching is `other`. `ops` is shown apart and left out of totals. `features` are the scripts/functions.json feature names whose Lambdas are charged to the family in attention-vs-effort. This classifies paths read from analytics; it builds no link (links come from shared/lib/links.js).
